extracted.intended_audience: researchers and systematic reviewers of digital mental health interventions (conversational agents/chatbots), meta-researchers, and OSF registrants
extracted.subtask_short: systematic review preregistration for MH chatbots
extracted.subtask_description: Preregistered plan for a PRISMA-ScR update mapping post-2020 evidence on conversational agents for mental health, cataloguing outcomes/instruments, and extracting RCT outcomes with CONSORT-AI/SPIRIT-AI flags. Focuses on study populations, conditions, settings, outcome domains, and RCT-level outcome plotting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Map post-2020 CA evidence for MH (populations, conditions, settings)
rubrics_metrics.description: Objectives: Map post-2020 CA evidence for MH (populations, conditions, settings).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extract and summarize what populations are studied, which mental health conditions are targeted, and the settings in which conversational agents are deployed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Catalogue outcomes & instruments (clinical, engagement, usability, safety, equity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Catalogue outcomes & instruments (clinical, engagement, usability, safety, equity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify and record the outcome measures and instruments used across studies, organized by the listed domains.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Clinical outcomes (listed as one of the outcome domains to be catalogued).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capture clinical endpoints (e.g., symptom scales, diagnostic outcomes) and the instruments used to measure them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engagement outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Engagement outcomes (listed as one of the outcome domains to be catalogued).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record metrics of user engagement (e.g., session counts, retention, interaction length) and how they are operationalized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Usability outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Usability outcomes (listed as one of the outcome domains to be catalogued).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document usability assessments, questionnaires, task success rates, and related instruments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Safety outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Safety outcomes (listed as one of the outcome domains to be catalogued).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capture reported harms, adverse events, escalation behavior, safeguarding measures, and safety-related instruments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equity outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Equity outcomes (listed as one of the outcome domains to be catalogued).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extract measures and considerations related to equity, access, demographic subgroup analyses, and differential effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Isolate RCTs
rubrics_metrics.description: Isolate RCTs as a distinct subset of the evidence base to be analyzed separately.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify randomized controlled trials among post-2020 studies for focused outcome extraction and plotting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Outcomes harvest plot dimensions: effect direction, comparator, timepoint
rubrics_metrics.description: Produce an outcomes harvest plot (effect direction, comparator, timepoint).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each RCT outcome, extract the direction of effect, the comparator used (e.g., waitlist, active control), and the timepoint at which the outcome was measured to populate the harvest plot.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply CONSORT-AI/SPIRIT-AI flags
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flag RCT reports according to CONSORT-AI and SPIRIT-AI reporting items to assess AI-specific reporting quality (e.g., description of algorithm, versioning, data handling).

rubrics_metrics.name: Assess reporting issues: versioning, guardrails, oversight
rubrics_metrics.description: Post-2020 growth includes LLM-era systems and rapid iteration that raises reporting issues (versioning, guardrails, oversight).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate whether studies report system versioning, safety guardrails, governance/oversight, and other iteration-related details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider system types: text/voice/embodied and LLM-era systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Conversational agents (text/voice/embodied) are increasingly deployed... Post-2020 growth includes LLM-era systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Classify conversational agents by modality (text, voice, embodied) and note whether systems are LLM-based or earlier architectures; consider implications for reporting and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assess measures and reporting consistency
rubrics_metrics.description: Recent syntheses show many MH chatbot studies and several RCT meta-analyses, but measures and reporting are inconsistent; LLM-based RCTs are only now emerging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate heterogeneity and consistency of outcome measures and reporting practices across studies; note gaps and emerging areas (e.g., LLM RCTs).
